description:
In personal discussions with people and hearing them talk about their experience with AI, I see a lot of misinformation and misunderstanding. In some cases, I see deep fear. In other cases I see a full trust when trust isn't warranted. AI can be useful but it has limitations and it has faults. AI can do things now for you but there safe and unsafe ways to use it. AI can be a huge privacy and surveillance risk if you do not know what you're doing.
